summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community have explored new logical types and data representations. One thread proposes a WIRE logical type to store serialized wire‑format messages while preserving raw bytes and allowing selective shredding. Another focuses on numeric vector types, suggesting metadata or Thrift fields to encode length constraints, and a separate discussion references the upcoming 1.19.0 release.

highlights.text: Proposal of a new WIRE logical type for storing serialized wire‑format messages while preserving original bytes and enabling selective shredding

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] WIRE: a logical type for serialized wire-format messages

highlights.text: Discussion on representing numeric vector types in Parquet, proposing metadata or Thrift fields to encode MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH constraints
